Thunder: target makes DC 17 Con save or Stunned (once per dawn)

weapons.name: Staff of Withering
weapons.properties: This staff has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. The staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff. On a hit, it deals damage as a normal Quarterstaff, and you can expend 1 charge to deal an extra 2d10 Necrotic damage to the target and force it to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has Disadvantage for 1 hour on any ability check or saving throw that uses Strength or Constitution.

weapons.name: Sun Blade
weapons.properties: This item appears to be a sword hilt. Blade of Radiance: While grasping the hilt, you can take a Bonus Action to cause a blade of pure radiance to spring into existence or make the blade disappear. While the blade exists, this magic weapon functions as a Longsword with the Finesse property. If you are proficient with Longswords or Shortswords, you are proficient with the Sun Blade. You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this weapon, which deals Radiant damage instead of Slashing damage. When you hit an Undead with it, that target takes an extra 1d8 Radiant damage. Sunlight: The sword's luminous blade emits Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 15 feet. The light is sunlight. While the blade persists, you can take a Magic action to expand or reduce its radius of Bright Light and Dim Light by 5 feet each, to a maximum of 30 feet each or a minimum of 10 feet each.

weapons.name: Sword of Life Stealing
weapons.type: Glaive, Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword
weapons.properties: When you attack a creature with this magic weapon and roll a 20 on the d20 for the attack roll, that target takes an extra 15 Necrotic damage if it isn't a Construct or an Undead, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the amount of Necrotic damage taken.

weapons.name: Sword of Sharpness
weapons.properties: When you attack an object with this magic weapon and hit, maximize your weapon damage dice against the target. When you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20 on the d20 for the attack roll, that target takes an extra 14 Slashing damage and gains 1 Exhaustion level.

weapons.name: Sword of Wounding
weapons.type: Glaive, Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword
weapons.properties: When you hit a creature with an attack using this magic weapon, the target takes an extra 2d6 Necrotic damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be unable to regain Hit Points for 1 hour. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

weapons.name: Thunderous Greatclub
weapons.properties: While you are attuned to this magic weapon, your Strength is 20 unless your Strength is already equal to or greater than that score. The weapon deals an extra 1d8 Thunder damage to any creature it hits and an extra 3d8 Thunder damage to objects it hits that aren't being worn or carried. Clap of Thunder: As a Magic action, you can strike the weapon against a hard surface to create a loud clap of thunder audible out to 300 feet. You also create a 30-foot Cone of thunderous energy. Each creature in the Cone must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or have the Prone condition. Nonmagical objects in the Cone that aren't being worn or carried take 3d8 Thunder damage. Earthquake: As a Magic action, you can strike the weapon against the ground to create an intense seismic disturbance in a 50-foot-radius circle centered on the point of impact. Structures in contact with the ground in that area take 50 Bludgeoning damage, and each creature on the ground in that area must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition. If that creature is also concentrating, it must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, or its Concentration is broken. In addition, you can cause a 30-foot-deep, 10-foot-wide fissure to open up on the ground anywhere in the area. Any creature on a spot where the fissure opens must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, falling into the fissure on a failed save or moving with the fissure's edge on a successful one. Any structure on a spot where the fissure opens collapses into the fissure. Once you use this property, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

weapons.name: Trident of Fish Command
weapons.properties: This magic weapon has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While you carry it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Dominate Beast (save DC 15) from it on a Beast that has a Swim Speed.

weapons.name: Vicious Weapon
weapons.properties: This magic weapon deals an extra 2d6 damage to any creature it hits. This extra damage is of the same type as the weapon's normal damage.

weapons.name: Vorpal Sword
weapons.properties: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, the weapon ignores Resistance to Slashing damage. When you use this weapon to attack a creature that has at least one head and roll a 20 on the d20 for the attack roll, you cut off one of the creature's heads. The creature dies if it can't survive without the lost head. A creature is immune to this effect if it has Immunity to Slashing damage, if it doesn't have or need a head, or if the GM decides that the creature is too big for its head to be cut off with this weapon. Such a creature instead takes an extra 30 Slashing damage from the hit. If the creature has Legendary Resistance, it can expend one daily use of that trait to avoid losing its head, taking the extra damage instead.

weapons.name: Weapon, +1, +2, or +3
weapons.properties: You have a bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity.

weapons.name: Weapon of Warning
weapons.properties: As long as this weapon is within your reach and you are attuned to it, you and allies within 30 feet of you gain the following benefits: Alarm: The weapon magically awakens each subject who is sleeping naturally when combat begins. This benefit doesn't wake a subject from magically induced sleep. Supernatural Readiness: Each subject has Advantage on its Initiative rolls.

armor.name: Adamantine Armor
armor.type: Armor (Any Medium or Heavy, Except Hide Armor)
armor.description: This suit of armor is reinforced with adamantine, one of the hardest substances in existence. While you're wearing it, any Critical Hit against you becomes a normal hit.

armor.name: Animated Shield
armor.description: While holding this shield, you can take a Bonus Action to speak its command word and have it animate. The shield then floats within 5 feet of you, and it grants you its normal bonus to AC as if you were wielding it. Its AC bonus is +2. If you drop the shield or are no longer attuned to it, it falls to the ground. The shield remains animated for 1 minute, until you take a Bonus Action to speak the command word again, or until it is destroyed. The shield has AC 18, 20 hit points, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.

armor.name: Armor, +1, +2, or +3
armor.description: You have a bonus to Armor Class while wearing this armor. The bonus is determined by its rarity.

armor.name: Armor of Invulnerability
armor.description:
You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage while you wear this armor.
Metal Shell. You can take a Magic action to give yourself Immunity to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage for 10 minutes or until you are no longer wearing the armor. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

armor.name: Armor of Resistance
armor.description: You have Resistance to one type of damage while you wear this armor. The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly by rolling on the following table.

armor.name: Armor of Vulnerability
armor.description:
While wearing this armor, you have Resistance to one of the following damage types: Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing. The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly.
Curse. This armor is cursed, a fact that is revealed only when the Identify spell is cast on the armor or you attune to it. Attuning to the armor curses you until you are targeted by a Remove Curse spell or similar magic; removing the armor fails to end the curse. While cursed, you have Vulnerability to two of the three damage types associated with the armor (not the one to which it grants Resistance).

armor.name: Arrow-Catching Shield
armor.description:
You gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class against ranged attack rolls while you wield this Shield. This bonus is in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC.
Whenever an attacker makes a ranged attack roll against a target within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to become the target of the attack instead.

armor.name: Demon Armor
traits: While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class, and you know Abyssal. In addition, the armor's gauntlets allow you to make unarmed Strikes to deal 1d8 Slashing damage instead of the usual Bludgeoning damage, and you gain a +1 bonus to the attack and damage rolls of your unarmed Strikes.

Curse: Once you don this cursed armor, you can't doff it unless you are targeted by a Remove Curse spell or similar magic. While wearing the armor, you have disadvantage on attack rolls against demons and on saving throws against their spells and special abilities.

armor.name: Dragon Scale Mail
traits: While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class, you have Advantage on saving throws against the breath weapons of Dragons, and you have Resistance to one damage type determined by the kind of dragon that provided the scales (see the accompanying table).

Additionally, you can focus your senses as a Magic action to discern the distance and direction to the closest dragon within 30 miles of yourself that is of the same type as the armor. This action can't be used again until the next dawn.

armor.name: Dwarven Plate
armor.type: Half Plate Armor or Plate Armor
traits: While wearing this armor, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class. In addition, if an effect moves you against your will along the ground, you can take a Reaction to reduce the distance you are moved by up to 10 feet.

armor.name: Elven Chain
armor.type: Chain Mail or Chain Shirt Armor
traits: You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class while you wear this armor. You are considered trained with this armor even if you lack training with Medium or Heavy Armor.

armor.name: Glamoured Studded Leather
traits: While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class. You can also take a Bonus Action to cause the armor to assume the appearance of a normal set of clothing or some other kind of armor. You decide what it looks like—including color, style, and accessories-but the armor retains its normal bulk and weight. The illusory appearance lasts until you use this property again or doff the armor.

armor.name: Mithral Armor
armor.type: Armor (Any Medium or Heavy, Except Hide Armor)
armor.description: Mithral is a light, flexible metal. Armor made of this substance can be worn under normal clothes. If the armor normally imposes Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks or has a Strength requirement, the mithral version of the armor doesn't.

armor.name: Plate Armor of Etherealness
armor.type: Armor (Half Plate Armor or Plate Armor)
armor.description: While you're wearing this armor, you can take a Magic action and use a command word to gain the effect of the Etherealness spell. The spell ends immediately if you remove the armor or take a Magic action to repeat the command word. This property of the armor can't be used again until the next dawn.

armor.name: Shield +1
properties: Bonus to Armor Class determined by rarity, in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC

armor.name: Shield +2
properties: Bonus to Armor Class determined by rarity, in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC

armor.name: Shield +3
properties: Bonus to Armor Class determined by rarity, in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC

armor.name: Shield of Missile Attraction
properties: Resistance to damage from attacks made with Ranged weapons
Cursed: Attuning to it curses you until Remove Curse or similar magic. Whenever a ranged attack targets a creature within 10 feet of you, the curse causes you to become the target instead.

armor.name: Shield of the Cavalier
properties: +2 bonus to Armor Class (in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC)

Forceful Bash: When you take the Attack action, you can make one attack with the Shield against a target within 5 feet. Apply Proficiency Bonus and Strength modifier to the attack roll. On a hit, deals 2d6 + Strength modifier Force damage, push target 10 feet. If target is your size or smaller, knock Prone.

Protective Field: As a Reaction, when you or an ally within 5 feet is targeted by an attack or area effect, create an immobile 5-foot Emanation. Creatures/objects not fully contained are pushed out. Attack/effect has no effect on creatures/objects inside. Lasts Concentration up to 1 minute. Nothing passes in/out. Can't be used again until next dawn.

armor.name: Spellguard Shield
properties: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects
Spell attack rolls have Disadvantage against you

conditions.name: Bloodied
conditions.description: A creature is bloodied when it is at half or less of its maximum hit points.

conditions.name: Stable
conditions.description: A creature is Stable if it has 0 Hit Points but isn't required to make Death Saving Throws.

conditions.name: Suffocating
conditions.description: A creature can hold its breath for a number of minutes equal to 1 + its Constitution modifier (minimum of 30 seconds). When a creature runs out of breath or is choking, it can survive for a number of rounds equal to its Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 round). At the start of its next turn, it drops to 0 hit points and is dying, and it can't regain hit points or be stabilized until it can breathe again.

conditions.name: Cursed
conditions.description: A creature under a curse suffers a detrimental effect, which varies depending on the nature of the curse.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Amphibious. The archelon can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Eldritch Restoration
traits.description: Eldritch Restoration. If destroyed, the aboleth gains a new body in 5d10 days, reviving with all its Hit Points in the Far Realm or another location chosen by the GM.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.description: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair). If the aboleth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Mucus Cloud
traits.description: Mucus Cloud. While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by mucus. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the aboleth at the end of the aboleth’s turn. Failure: The target is cursed. Until the curse ends, the target’s skin becomes slimy, the target can breathe air and water, and it can’t regain Hit Points unless it is underwater. While the cursed creature is outside a body of water, the creature takes 6 (1d12) Acid damage at the end of every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to its skin before those minutes have passed.

traits.name: Probing Telepathy
traits.description: Probing Telepathy. If a creature the aboleth can see communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature’s greatest desires.

traits.name: Air Form
traits.description: Air Form. The elemental can enter a creature’s space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: Tunneler. The ankheg can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: Evasion. If the assassin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the assassin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails. It can’t use this trait if it has the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.description: Fire Aura. At the end of each of the elemental’s turns, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the elemental takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage. Creatures and flammable objects in the Emanation start burning.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: Illumination. The elemental sheds Bright Light in a 30- foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.description: Death Throes. The balor explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the balor. Failure: 31 (9d6) Fire damage plus 31 (9d6) Force damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: If the balor dies outside the Abyss, it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: Legendary Resistance (3/Day). If the unicorn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Barbed Hide
traits.description: Barbed Hide. At the start of each of its turns, the devil deals 5 (1d10) Piercing damage to any creature it is grappling or any creature grappling it.

traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
traits.description: Diabolical Restoration. If the pit fiend dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

traits.name: Bloodied Frenzy
traits.description: Bloodied Frenzy. While Bloodied, the berserker has Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.description: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair). If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: Amorphous. The pudding can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Corrosive Form
traits.description: Corrosive Form. A creature that hits the pudding with a melee attack roll takes 4 (1d8) Acid damage. Nonmagical ammunition is destroyed immediately after hitting the pudding and dealing any damage. Any nonmagical weapon takes a cumulative −1 penalty to attack rolls immediately after dealing damage to the pudding and coming into contact with it. The weapon is destroyed if the penalty reaches −5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the weapon. In 1 minute, the pudding can eat through 2 feet of nonmagical wood or metal.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Spider Climb. If the swarm has a Climb Speed, the swarm can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Abduct
traits.description: Abduct. The bugbear needn’t spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.

traits.name: Sense Magic
traits.description: Sense Magic. The chuul senses magic within 120 feet of itself. This trait otherwise works like the Detect Magic spell but isn’t itself magical.

traits.name: Acid Absorption
traits.description: Acid Absorption. Whenever the golem is subjected to Acid damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Acid damage dealt.

traits.name: Berserk
traits.description: Berserk. Whenever the golem starts its turn Bloodied, roll 1d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it remains so until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied. The golem’s creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by taking an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check; the golem must be able to hear its creator. If this check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk until the start of its next turn, at which point it resumes rolling for the Berserk trait again if it is still Bloodied.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: Immutable Form. The golem can’t shape-shift.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.description: Light Sensitivity. While in Bright Light, the cloaker has Disadvantage on attack rolls.

traits.name: Training
traits.description: Training. The commoner has proficiency in one skill of the GM’s choice and has Advantage whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

traits.name: Shielded Mind
traits.description: Shielded Mind. The couatl’s thoughts can’t be read by any means, and other creatures can communicate with it telepathically only if it allows them.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: Swarm. The swarm can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can’t regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Exalted Restoration
traits.description: Exalted Restoration. If the planetar dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.

traits.name: Elemental Restoration
traits.description: Elemental Restoration. If the efreeti dies outside the Elemental Plane of Fire, its body dissolves into ash, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Fire.

traits.name: Wishes
traits.description: Wishes. The efreeti has a 30 percent chance of knowing the Wish spell. If the efreeti knows it, the efreeti can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the efreeti can understand. If the efreeti casts the spell for the creature, the efreeti suffers none of the spell’s stress. Once the efreeti has cast it three times, the efreeti can’t do so again for 365 days.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.description: Web Walker. The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the ettercap knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.description: Speak with Beasts and Plants. The dryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: Earth Glide. The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn’t disturb the material it moves through.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: Siege Monster. The elemental deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Magic Rope
traits.description: Magic Rope. The erinyes has a magic rope. While bearing it, the erinyes can use the Entangling Rope action. The rope has AC 20, HP 90, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. The rope turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points, if it is 5+ feet away from the erinyes for 1 hour or more, or if the erinyes dies. If the rope is damaged or destroyed, the erinyes can fully restore it when finishing a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.description: Fire Form. The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature’s space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature’s space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.description: Water Susceptibility. The elemental takes 3 (1d6) Cold damage for every 5 feet the elemental moves in water or for every gallon of water splashed on it.

traits.name: Aversion to Fire
traits.description: Aversion to Fire. If the golem takes Fire damage, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.description: Lightning Absorption. Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: Flyby. The hippogriff doesn’t provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

traits.name: Ooze Cube
traits.description: Ooze Cube. The cube fills its entire space and is transparent. Other creatures can enter that space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the cube’s Engulf and has Disadvantage on the saving throw. Creatures inside the cube have Total Cover, and the cube can hold one Large creature or up to four Medium or Small creatures inside itself at a time. As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the cube can pull a creature or an object out of the cube by succeeding on a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check, and the puller takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage.

traits.name: Transparent
traits.description: Transparent. Even when the cube is in plain sight, a creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice the cube if the creature hasn’t witnessed the cube move or otherwise act.

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: Stench. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, any creature that starts its turn in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the ghast. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this ghast’s Stench for 24 hours.

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.description: Ethereal Sight. The spider can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane while on the Material Plane and vice versa.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: Incorporeal Movement. The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Aberrant Ground
traits.description: Aberrant Ground. The ground in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the mouther is Difficult Terrain.

traits.name: Gibbering
traits.description: Gibbering. The mouther babbles incoherently while it doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, any creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the mouther while it is babbling. Failure: The target rolls 1d8 to determine what it does during the current turn: 1–4. The target does nothing. 5–6. The target takes no action or Bonus Action and uses all its movement to move in a random direction. 7–8. The target makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can’t make such an attack.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.description: Demonic Restoration. If the nalfeshnee dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Coven Magic
traits.description: Coven Magic. While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell’s normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11): Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, or Unseen Servant. The hag must finish a Long Rest before using this trait to cast that spell again.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: Mimicry. The raven can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a whisper or chitter. A hearer can discern the sounds are imitations with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

traits.name: Celestial Restoration
traits.description: Celestial Restoration. If the naga dies, it returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points unless Dispel Evil and Good is cast on its remains.

traits.name: Draconic Origin
traits.description: Draconic Origin. The half-dragon is related to a type of dragon associated with one of the following damage types (GM’s choice): Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. This choice affects other aspects of the stat block.

traits.name: Aura of Authority
traits.description: Aura of Authority. While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the hobgoblin, the hobgoblin and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the hobgoblin doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Telepathic Bond
traits.description: Telepathic Bond. While the homunculus is on the same plane of existence as its master, the two of them can communicate telepathically with each other.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: Hold Breath. The hippopotamus can hold its breath for 10 minutes.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.description: Multiple Heads. The hydra has five heads. Whenever the hydra takes 25 damage or more on a single turn, one of its heads dies. The hydra dies if all its heads are dead. At the end of each of its turns when it has at least one living head, the hydra grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken Fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 20 Hit Points when it grows new heads.

traits.name: Reactive Heads
traits.description: Reactive Heads. For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra Reaction that can be used only for Opportunity Attacks.

traits.name: Succubus Form
traits.description: Succubus Form. When the incubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into a Succubus, using that stat block instead of this one. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.

traits.name: Invisibility
traits.description: Invisibility. The stalker has the Invisible condition.

traits.name: Fire Absorption
traits.description: Fire Absorption. Whenever the golem is subjected to Fire damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Fire damage dealt.

traits.name: Hellish Restoration
traits.description: Hellish Restoration. If the lemure dies in the Nine Hells, it revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 days unless it is killed by a creature under the effects of a Bless spell or its remains are sprinkled with Holy Water.

traits.name: Spirit Jar
traits.description: Spirit Jar. If destroyed, the lich reforms in 1d10 days if it has a spirit jar, reviving with all its Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the lich’s lair.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: Death Burst. The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.

traits.name: Reactive
traits.description: Reactive. The marilith can take one Reaction on every turn of combat.

traits.name: Blurred Form
traits.description: Blurred Form. Attack rolls against the mephit are made with Disadvantage unless the mephit has the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
traits.description: Adhesive (Object Form Only). The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Undead Restoration
traits.description: Undead Restoration. If destroyed, the mummy gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, reviving with all its Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the mummy’s lair. The heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and Immunity to all damage except Fire.

traits.name: Soul Bag
traits.description: Soul Bag. The hag has a soul bag. While holding or carrying the bag, the hag can use its Nightmare Haunting action. The bag has AC 15, HP 20, and Resistance to all damage. The bag turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points. If the bag is destroyed, any souls the bag is holding are released. The hag can create a new bag after 7 days.

traits.name: Confer Fire Resistance
traits.description: Confer Fire Resistance. The nightmare can grant Resistance to Fire damage to a rider while it is on the nightmare.

traits.name: Fear Aura
traits.description: Fear Aura. The pit fiend emanates an aura in a 20- foot Emanation while it doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 21, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this pit fiend’s aura for 24 hours.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.description: Legendary Resistance (4/Day). If the pit fiend fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.description: Divine Awareness. The planetar knows if it hears a lie.

traits.name: Greater Magic Resistance
traits.description: Greater Magic Resistance. The rakshasa automatically succeeds on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and the attack rolls of spells automatically miss it. Without the rakshasa’s permission, no spell can observe the rakshasa remotely or detect its thoughts, creature type, or alignment.

traits.name: Fiendish Restoration
traits.description: Fiendish Restoration. If the rakshasa dies outside the Nine Hells, its body turns to ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

traits.name: Heat Aura
traits.description: Heat Aura. At the end of each of the remorhaz’s turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the remorhaz takes 16 (3d10) Fire damage.

traits.name: Iron Scent
traits.description: Iron Scent. The rust monster can pinpoint the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of itself.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.description: Blood Frenzy. The sahuagin has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that doesn’t have all its Hit Points.

traits.name: Limited Amphibiousness
traits.description: Limited Amphibiousness. The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it must be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating outside water.

traits.name: Shark Telepathy
traits.description: Shark Telepathy. The sahuagin can magically control sharks within 120 feet of itself, using a special telepathy.

traits.name: Vile Appearance
traits.description: Vile Appearance. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, any Beast or Humanoid that starts its turn within 30 feet of the hag and can see the hag’s true form. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this hag’s Vile Appearance for 24 hours.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.description: Sunlight Weakness. While in sunlight, the shadow has Disadvantage on D20 Tests.

traits.name: Bound
traits.description: Bound. The guardian is magically bound to an amulet. While the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet’s wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet’s wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (round up) is transferred to the guardian.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: Regeneration. The troll regains 15 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn’t function on the troll’s next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn’t regenerate.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: Regeneration. The limb regains 5 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the limb takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn’t function on the limb’s next turn. The limb dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn’t regenerate.

traits.name: Spell Storing
traits.description: Spell Storing. A spellcaster who wears the guardian’s amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of level 4 or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian while within 5 feet of it. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. Any previously stored spell is lost when a new spell is stored. The guardian can cast the spell stored with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no spell components and using the caster’s spellcasting ability. The stored spell is then lost.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.description: Inscrutable. No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sin cerity are made with Disadvantage.

traits.name: Incubus Form
traits.description: Incubus Form. When the succubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into an Incubus, using that stat block instead of this one.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (6/Day)
traits.description: Legendary Resistance (6/Day). If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Reflective Carapace
traits.description: Reflective Carapace. If the tarrasque is targeted by a Magic Missile spell or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll 1d6. On a 1–5, the tarrasque is unaffected. On a 6, the tarrasque is unaffected and reflects the spell, turning the caster into the target.

traits.name: Loathsome Limbs (4/Day)
traits.description: Loathsome Limbs (4/Day). If the troll ends any turn Bloodied and took 15+ Slashing damage during that turn, one of the troll’s limbs is severed, falls into the troll’s space, and becomes a Troll Limb. The limb acts immediately after the troll’s turn. The troll has 1 Exhaustion level for each missing limb, and it grows replacement limbs the next time it regains Hit Points.

traits.name: Troll Spawn
traits.description: Troll Spawn. The limb uncannily has the same senses as a whole troll. If the limb isn’t destroyed within 24 hours, roll 1d12. On a 12, the limb turns into a Troll. Otherwise, the limb withers away.

traits.name: Vampiric Connection
traits.description: Vampiric Connection. While the familiar and its vampire master are on the same plane of existence, the vampire can communicate with the familiar telepathically, and the vampire can perceive through the familiar’s senses.

traits.name: Vampire Weakness
traits.description: Vampire Weakness. The vampire has these weaknesses:

traits.name: Forbiddance
traits.description: Forbiddance. The vampire can’t enter a residence without an invitation from an occupant.

traits.name: Running Water
traits.description: Running Water. The vampire takes 20 Acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.

traits.name: Stake to the Heart
traits.description: Stake to the Heart. If a weapon that deals Piercing damage is driven into the vampire’s heart while the vampire has the Incapacitated condition in its resting place, the vampire has the Paralyzed condition until the weapon is removed.

traits.name: Sunlight
traits.description: Sunlight. The vampire takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

traits.name: Misty Escape
traits.description: Misty Escape. If the vampire drops to 0 Hit Points outside its resting place, the vampire uses Shape-Shift to become mist (no action required). If it can’t use Shape-Shift, it is destroyed. While it has 0 Hit Points in mist form, it can’t return to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it returns to its vampire form and has the Paralyzed condition until it regains any Hit Points, and it regains 1 Hit Point after spending 1 hour there.

traits.name: Freeze
traits.description: Freeze. If the elemental takes Cold damage, its Speed decreases by 20 feet until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Water Form
traits.description: Water Form. The elemental can enter an enemy’s space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.description: Ice Walk. The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, Difficult Terrain composed of ice or snow doesn’t cost it extra movement.

traits.name: Ephemeral
traits.description: Ephemeral. The wisp can’t wear or carry anything.

traits.name: Treasure Sense
traits.description: Treasure Sense. The xorn can pinpoint the location of precious metals and stones within 60 feet of itself.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: Undead Fortitude. If damage reduces the zombie to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the zombie drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

traits.name: Bloodied Fury
traits.description: Bloodied Fury. The boar has Advantage on melee attack rolls while it is Bloodied.

traits.name: Jumper
traits.description: Jumper. The cat’s jump distance is determined using its Dexterity rather than its Strength.

traits.name: Agile
traits.description: Agile. The deer doesn’t provoke an Opportunity Attack when it moves out of an enemy’s reach.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: Standing Leap. The frog’s Long Jump is up to 20 feet and its High Jump is up to 10 feet with or without a running start.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.description: Water Breathing. The octopus can breathe only underwater. It can hold its breath for 1 hour outside water.

traits.name: Running Leap
traits.description: Running Leap. With a 10-foot running start, the tiger can Long Jump up to 25 feet.

traits.name: Beast of Burden
traits.description: Beast of Burden. The mule counts as one size larger for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

traits.name: Compression
traits.description: Compression. The octopus can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Blessed Strikes
traits.description: Divine power infuses you in battle. You gain one of the following options of your choice: Divine Strike or Potent Spellcasting.

traits.name: Divine Intervention
traits.description: As a Magic action, choose any Cleric spell of level 5 or lower that doesn't require a Reaction to cast. You cast that spell without expending a spell slot or needing Material components.

traits.name: Improved Blessed Strikes
traits.description: The option you chose for Blessed Strikes grows more powerful (Divine Strike increases to 2d8 extra damage; Potent Spellcasting grants Temporary Hit Points).

traits.name: Epic Boon
traits.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Fate is recommended.

traits.name: Greater Divine Intervention
traits.description: When you use your Divine Intervention feature, you can choose Wish when you select a spell. If you do so, you can't use Divine Intervention again until you finish 2d4 Long Rests.

traits.name: Disciple of Life
traits.description: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points to a creature, that creature regains additional Hit Points equal to 2 plus the spell slot's level.

traits.name: Life Domain Spells
traits.description: You always have certain domain spells prepared based on your Cleric level.

traits.name: Preserve Life
traits.description: As a Magic action, expend a use of Channel Divinity to restore Hit Points equal to 5 times your Cleric level divided among Bloodied creatures within 30 feet.

traits.name: Blessed Healer
traits.description: Immediately after you cast a spell with a spell slot that restores Hit Points to one or more creatures other than yourself, you regain Hit Points equal to 2 plus the spell slot's level.

traits.name: Supreme Healing
traits.description: When you would normally roll dice to restore Hit Points to a creature with a spell or Channel Divinity, use the highest number possible for each die.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description: You can cast Druid spells through studying the mystical forces of nature.

traits.name: Druidic
traits.description: You know Druidic, the secret language of Druids. You always have Speak with Animals prepared and can leave hidden messages.

traits.name: Primal Order
traits.description: Choose Magician (extra cantrip, bonus to Arcana/Nature checks) or Warden (proficiency with Martial weapons and Medium armor).

traits.name: Wild Shape
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, shape-shift into a Beast form that you have learned for this feature.

traits.name: Wild Companion
traits.description: As a Magic action, expend a spell slot or use of Wild Shape to cast Find Familiar without Material components.

traits.name: Druid Subclass
traits.description: Choose a Druid subclass, such as Circle of the Land.

traits.name: Ability Score Improvement
traits.description: Gain an Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice.

traits.name: Wild Resurgence
traits.description: Give yourself one use of Wild Shape by expending a spell slot, or expend one use of Wild Shape to gain a level 1 spell slot once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Elemental Fury
traits.description: Choose Potent Spellcasting (add Wisdom modifier to Druid cantrip damage) or Primal Strike (extra 1d8 elemental damage on attack hits).

traits.name: Improved Elemental Fury
traits.description: Enhance your Elemental Fury option: Potent Spellcasting range increases by 300 feet, or Primal Strike damage increases to 2d8.

traits.name: Beast Spells
traits.description: Cast spells while in Wild Shape Beast form, unless the spell requires costly or consumed Material components.

traits.name: Archdruid
traits.description: Gain Evergreen Wild Shape, Nature Magician, and Longevity.

traits.name: Circle of the Land Spells
traits.description: Choose a land type (arid, polar, temperate, or tropical) after a Long Rest to gain specified spells prepared.

traits.name: Land's Aid
traits.description: As a Magic action, expend a Wild Shape use to deal 2d6 Necrotic damage to selected creatures in a 10-foot Sphere and heal one creature for 2d6 HP.

traits.name: Natural Recovery
traits.description: Cast one level 1+ prepared Circle Spell without expending a spell slot once per Long Rest, and recover spell slots during a Short Rest.

traits.name: Nature's Ward
traits.description: Gain immunity to the Poisoned condition and Resistance to a damage type based on your land choice.

traits.name: Nature's Sanctuary
traits.description: As a Magic action, expend a Wild Shape use to create spectral trees in a 15-foot Cube providing Half Cover and damage Resistance to allies.

traits.name: Fighting Style
traits.description: Gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice.

traits.name: Second Wind
traits.description: Regain Hit Points using a bonus action.

traits.name: Weapon Mastery
traits.description: Master specific weapon properties.

traits.name: Action Surge
traits.description: Take one additional action on your turn.

traits.name: Tactical Mind
traits.description: Expend a use of Second Wind to add to a failed ability check.

traits.name: Fighter Subclass
traits.description: Gain features from your chosen Fighter subclass.

traits.name: Extra Attack
traits.description: Attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action.

traits.name: Tactical Shift
traits.description: Move without provoking Opportunity Attacks when using Second Wind.

traits.name: Indomitable
traits.description: Reroll a failed saving throw.

traits.name: Tactical Master
traits.description: Use Push, Sap, or Slow mastery properties with weapons you master.

traits.name: Two Extra Attacks
traits.description: Attack three times whenever you take the Attack action.

traits.name: Studied Attacks
traits.description: Gain Advantage on your next attack roll against a target after missing it.

traits.name: Three Extra Attacks
traits.description: Attack four times whenever you take the Attack action.

traits.name: Expertise
traits.description: Gain Expertise in two skill proficiencies of your choice. At level 6, gain Expertise in two more.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.description: Once per turn, deal extra damage to one creature hit with an attack roll if you have Advantage and use a Finesse or Ranged weapon, or if an active, non-incapacitated ally is within 5 feet of the target.

traits.name: Thieves' Cant
traits.description: Know Thieves' Cant and one other language of your choice.

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.description: Take Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a Bonus Action on your turn.

traits.name: Steady Aim
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, give yourself Advantage on your next attack roll on the current turn, provided you haven't moved.

traits.name: Cunning Strike
traits.description: Forgo Sneak Attack damage dice to add special effects such as Poison, Trip, or Withdraw.

traits.name: Uncanny Dodge
traits.description: Use a Reaction to halve an attacker's damage against you when you are hit with an attack roll you can see.

traits.name: Reliable Talent
traits.description: Treat any d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10 on ability checks using a skill or tool proficiency.

traits.name: Improved Cunning Strike
traits.description: Use up to two Cunning Strike effects when dealing Sneak Attack damage.

traits.name: Devious Strikes
traits.description: Adds Daze, Knock Out, and Obscure to your Cunning Strike options.

traits.name: Slippery Mind
traits.description: Gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Elusive
traits.description: No attack roll can have Advantage against you unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Stroke of Luck
traits.description: Turn a failed D20 Test into a 20 once per Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Hunter's Lore
traits.description: Know whether a target marked by Hunter's Mark has Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities and what they are.

traits.name: Hunter's Prey
traits.description: Choose between Colossus Slayer (extra 1d8 damage to damaged targets) or Horde Breaker (extra attack against adjacent target).

traits.name: Defensive Tactics
traits.description: Choose between Escape the Horde (Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage) or Multiattack Defense (Disadvantage on subsequent attacks from the same creature).

traits.name: Superior Hunter's Prey
traits.description: Deal Hunter's Mark extra damage to a second target within 30 feet once per turn.

traits.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
traits.description: Use a Reaction when taking damage to gain Resistance to that damage type until the end of the current turn.

traits.name: Fast Hands
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, make a Sleight of Hand check or use the Utilize/Magic action for magic items.

traits.name: Second-Story Work
traits.description: Gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed and determine jump distance using Dexterity.

traits.name: Supreme Sneak
traits.description: Gain Stealth Attack Cunning Strike option: maintaining Invisible condition when ending turn behind cover.

traits.name: Use Magic Device
traits.description: Attune to up to four magic items, chance to preserve item charges, and use any Spell Scroll.

traits.name: Thief's Reflexes
traits.description: Take two turns during the first round of combat.

traits.name: Innate Sorcery
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, unleash magic for 1 minute to increase spell save DC by 1 and gain Advantage on Sorcerer spell attack rolls.

traits.name: Font of Magic
traits.description: Gain Sorcery Points to convert spell slots or create new spell slots.

traits.name: Metamagic
traits.description: Alter spells using Sorcery Points with Metamagic options such as Careful, Distant, Empowered, Extended, Heightened, Quickened, Seeking, Subtle, Transmuted, and Twinned.

traits.name: Sorcerous Restoration
traits.description: Regain expended Sorcery Points equal to half your Sorcerer level on a Short Rest once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Sorcery Incarnate
traits.description: Spend Sorcery Points to activate Innate Sorcery and use up to two Metamagic options per spell.

traits.name: Arcane Apotheosis
traits.description: While Innate Sorcery is active, use one Metamagic option each turn without spending Sorcery Points.

traits.name: Draconic Resilience
traits.description: The magic in your body manifests physical traits of your draconic gift. Your Hit Point maximum increases by 3, and it increases by 1 whenever you gain another Sorcerer level. While you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers.

traits.name: Draconic Spells
traits.description: When you reach a Sorcerer level specified in the Draconic Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

traits.name: Elemental Affinity
traits.description: Choose one damage type associated with dragons: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. You have Resistance to that damage type, and when you cast a spell that deals damage of that type, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

traits.name: Dragon Wings
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, you can cause draconic wings to appear on your back for 1 hour or until dismissed. You gain a Fly Speed of 60 feet.

traits.name: Dragon Companion
traits.description: You can cast Summon Dragon without a Material component, and once per Long Rest without a spell slot. You can modify it to not require Concentration, changing its duration to 1 minute.

traits.name: Eldritch Invocations
traits.description: You gain invocations of your choice that imbue you with magic or lessons.

traits.name: Pact Magic
traits.description: You can cast Warlock spells using Pact Magic spell slots, which are all of the same level and recharge on a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Magical Cunning
traits.description: You can perform a 1-minute rite to regain expended Pact Magic spell slots up to half your maximum.

traits.name: Contact Patron
traits.description: You always have Contact Other Plane prepared and can cast it without a spell slot to contact your patron.

traits.name: Mystic Arcanum
traits.description: Your patron grants you high-level arcanum spells (6th through 9th level) that can each be cast once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot.

traits.name: Eldritch Master
traits.description: When you use Magical Cunning, you regain all your expended Pact Magic spell slots.

traits.name: Dark One's Blessing
traits.description: When you reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points (or one dies within 10 feet of you), you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Warlock level.

traits.name: Fiend Spells
traits.description: You always have the listed fiend spells prepared once you reach specific Warlock levels.

traits.name: Dark One's Own Luck
traits.description: You can add 1d10 to an ability check or saving throw.

traits.name: Fiendish Resilience
traits.description: Choose one damage type (other than Force) after a rest to gain Resistance to until you choose another.

traits.name: Hurl Through Hell
traits.description: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can banish it to the Lower Planes, dealing 8d10 Psychic damage if it isn't a Fiend and inflicting Incapacitated until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Ritual Adept
traits.description: You can cast any Wizard spell as a Ritual if it has the Ritual tag and is in your spellbook.

traits.name: Arcane Recovery
traits.description: Once per day when you finish a Short Rest, you can recover expended spell slots.

traits.name: Scholar
traits.description: You gain expertise in one of your proficient Wizard skills.

traits.name: Memorize Spell
traits.description: You can swap one prepared spell during a Short Rest.

traits.name: Spell Mastery
traits.description: Choose a 1st-level and a 2nd-level Wizard spell in your spellbook to cast at their lowest level without expending a spell slot.

traits.name: Signature Spells
traits.description: Choose two 3rd-level spells in your spellbook as signature spells, casting each once per Short or Long Rest without a slot.

traits.name: Evocation Savant
traits.description: Choose two Wizard spells from the Evocation school (level 2 or lower) and add them to your spellbook for free. Whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots, add one Wizard Evocation spell to your spellbook for free.

traits.name: Potent Cantrip
traits.description: When you cast a cantrip at a creature and miss with the attack roll or the target succeeds on a saving throw, the target takes half damage (if any).

traits.name: Sculpt Spells
traits.description: When you cast an Evocation spell affecting other creatures, choose 1 + spell level creatures. They automatically succeed on saving throws and take no damage if they would take half on a save.

traits.name: Empowered Evocation
traits.description: Add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of any Wizard Evocation spell you cast.

traits.name: Overchannel
traits.description: When casting a level 1-5 Wizard spell that deals damage, deal maximum damage. Subsequent uses before a Long Rest cause Necrotic damage to you.

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: Choose a dragon ancestor, determining your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance damage type.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: Exhale magical energy in a 15-foot Cone or 30-foot Line dealing 1d10 damage (scales with level) on a failed Dexterity save.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: 60 feet of Darkvision.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.description: At level 5, gain temporary flight as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saving throws against Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Hit Point maximum increases by 1, plus 1 for every level gained.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, gain Tremorsense 60 ft. while touching stone for 10 minutes.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.description: Choose a lineage (Drow, High Elf, or Wood Elf) granting specific spells.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: Proficiency in Insight, Perception, or Survival.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: Finish a Long Rest in 4 hours of meditation.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.description: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Gnomish Lineage
traits.description: Choose Forest Gnome or Rock Gnome.

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.description: Choose a supernatural boon based on giant ancestry.

traits.name: Large Form
traits.description: At level 5, change size to Large as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: Advantage on checks to end Grappled condition and count as one size larger for carrying capacity.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: Advantage on saves against Frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: Move through the space of any larger creature.

traits.name: Luck
traits.description: Reroll a 1 on a d20 test.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: Take Hide action when obscured by a larger creature.

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.description: Gain Heroic Inspiration after a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.description: Proficiency in one skill of choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.description: Gain one Origin feat of choice.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.description: Dash as a Bonus Action and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to Proficiency Bonus.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When reduced to 0 HP, drop to 1 HP instead once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Fiendish Legacy
traits.description: Choose Abyssal, Chthonic, or Infernal legacy granting specific traits and spells.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.description: Know the Thaumaturgy cantrip.

traits.name: Ability Scores
traits.description: Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma

traits.name: Feat
traits.description: Magic Initiate (Cleric)

traits.name: Initiative Proficiency
traits.description: Add Proficiency Bonus to Initiative rolls.

traits.name: Initiative Swap
traits.description: Swap Initiative with a willing ally after rolling.

traits.name: Two Cantrips
traits.description: Learn two cantrips from Cleric, Druid, or Wizard list.

traits.name: Level 1 Spell
traits.description: Learn one level 1 spell from chosen spell list, castable once without spell slot per Long Rest.

traits.name: Benefit
traits.description: Roll weapon damage dice twice once per turn and use either roll.

traits.name: Punch and Grab
traits.description: Use both Damage and Grapple on Unarmed Strike.

traits.name: Attack Advantage
traits.description: Advantage on attack rolls against grappled targets.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

traits.name: Peerless Aim
traits.description: When you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until the start of your next turn.

traits.name: Blink Steps
traits.description: Immediately after you take the Attack action or the Magic action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

traits.name: Improve Fate
traits.description: When you or another creature within 60 feet of you succeeds on or fails a D20 Test, you can roll 2d4 and apply the total rolled as a bonus or penalty to the d20 roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Overcome Defenses
traits.description: The Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you deal always ignores Resistance.

traits.name: Overwhelming Strike
traits.description: When you roll a 20 on the d20 for an attack roll, you can deal extra damage to the target equal to the ability score increased by this feat. The extra damage's type is the same as the attack's type.

traits.name: Free Casting
traits.description: Whenever you cast a spell with a level 1–4 spell slot, roll 1d4. If the number you roll is the same as the slot's level, the slot isn't expended.

traits.name: Merge with Shadows
traits.description: While within Dim Light or Darkness, you can give yourself the Invisible condition as a Bonus Action. The condition ends on you immediately after you take an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction.

traits.name: Shadowy Form
traits.description: While within Dim Light or Darkness, you have Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant.

traits.name: Truesight
traits.description: You have Truesight with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Demonic Possession
traits.description: A creature that becomes the target of Demonic Possession must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by a bodiless demonic entity. Whenever the possessed creature rolls a 1 on a D20 Test, the demonic entity takes control of the creature and determines the creature's behavior thereafter. At the end of each of the possessed creature's later turns, the creature makes a DC 15 Charisma saving throw, regaining control of itself on a success. After finishing a Long Rest, a creature with Demonic Possession makes a DC 15 Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, the effect ends on the creature. A Dispel Evil and Good spell or any magic that removes a curse also ends the effect on it.

traits.name: Cackle Fever
traits.description: A magical contagion affecting Humanoids (gnomes immune). 1d4 days after infection: Fever (1 Exhaustion level until contagion ends), Uncontrollable Laughter (while Exhausted, creature makes DC 13 Con save each time it takes non-Psychic damage; on failed save, takes 5 (1d10) Psychic damage and Incapacitated, repeats save at end of turn, ends on success, or automatically after 1 minute). Fighting: DC 13 Con save at end of each Long Rest; 3 successes end contagion and grant 1-year immunity. Spreading: Humanoid (non-gnome) within 10-foot Emanation must succeed on DC 10 Con save or become infected; successful save grants 24-hour immunity from that creature.

traits.name: Sewer Plague
traits.description: A magical contagion. Any Humanoid wounded by a carrier or in contact with contaminated filth/offal must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or become infected. 1d4 days after infection: Fatigue (1 Exhaustion level), Weakness (while Exhausted, regains only half normal HP from Hit Dice), Restlessness (while Exhausted, Long Rest neither restores lost HP nor reduces Exhaustion). Fighting: Daily at dawn, DC 11 Con save; failed save gains 1 Exhaustion, successful save decreases Exhaustion by 1. Contagion ends if Exhaustion reduced to 0.

traits.name: Sight Rot
traits.description: A magical contagion. Any Beast or Humanoid that drinks tainted water must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition until the contagion ends. Fighting: Heal or Lesser Restoration ends it. Herbalism Kit user can create nonmagical ointment (1 hour, 1 dose) which suppresses contagion for 24 hours when applied; 72 hours of suppression (3 doses) ends contagion. Spreading: Any Humanoid making skin contact with infected creature must succeed on a DC 15 Con save or become infected; successful save grants 24-hour immunity from that creature.

traits.name: Balance
traits.description: You can increase one of your ability scores by 2, to a maximum of 22, provided you also decrease another one of your ability scores by 2. You can't decrease an ability that has a score of 5 or lower. Alternatively, you can choose not to adjust your ability scores, in which case this card has no effect.

traits.name: Comet
traits.description: The next time you enter combat against one or more Hostile creatures, you can select one of them as your foe when you roll Initiative. If you reduce your foe to 0 Hit Points during that combat, you have Advantage on Death Saving Throws for 1 year. If someone else reduces your chosen foe to 0 Hit Points or you don't choose a foe, this card has no effect.

traits.name: Donjon
traits.description: You disappear and become entombed in a state of suspended animation in an extradimensional sphere. Everything you're wearing and carrying disappears with you except for Artifacts, which stay behind in the space you occupied when you disappeared. You remain imprisoned until you are found and removed from the sphere. You can't be located by any Divination magic, but a Wish spell can reveal the location of your prison. You draw no more cards.

traits.name: Euryale
traits.description: The card's medusa-like visage curses you. You take a -2 penalty to saving throws while cursed in this way. Only a god or the magic of the Fates card can end this curse.

traits.name: Fates
traits.description: Reality's fabric unravels and spins anew, allowing you to avoid or erase one event as if it never happened. You can use the card's magic as soon as you draw the card or at any other time before you die.

traits.name: Flames
traits.description: A powerful devil becomes your enemy. The devil seeks your ruin and torments you, savoring your suffering before attempting to slay you. This enmity lasts until either you or the devil dies.

traits.name: Fool
traits.description: You have Disadvantage on D20 Tests for the next 72 hours. Draw another card; this draw doesn't count as one of your declared draws.

traits.name: Gem
traits.description: Twenty-five pieces of jewelry worth 2,000 GP each or fifty gems worth 1,000 GP each appear at your feet.

traits.name: Jester
traits.description: You have Advantage on D20 Tests for the next 72 hours, or you can draw two additional cards beyond your declared draws.

traits.name: Key
traits.description: A Rare or rarer magic weapon with which you are proficient appears on your person. The GM chooses the weapon.

traits.name: Knight
traits.description: You gain the service of a Knight, who magically appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 30 feet of yourself. The knight has the same alignment as you and serves you loyally until death, believing the two of you have been drawn together by fate. Work with your GM to create a name and backstory for this NPC. The GM can use a different stat block to represent the knight, as desired.

traits.name: Moon
traits.description: You gain the ability to cast Wish 1d3 times.

traits.name: Puzzle
traits.description: Permanently reduce your Intelligence or Wisdom by 1d4 + 1 (to a minimum score of 1). You can draw one additional card beyond your declared draws.

traits.name: Rogue
traits.description: An NPC of the GM's choice becomes Hostile toward you. You don't know the identity of this NPC until they or someone else reveals it. Nothing less than a Wish spell or divine intervention can end the NPC's hostility toward you.

traits.name: Ruin
traits.description: All forms of wealth that you carry or own, other than magic items, are lost to you. Portable property vanishes. Businesses, buildings, and land you own are lost in a way that alters reality the least. Any documentation that proves you should own something lost to this card also disappears.

traits.name: Sage
traits.description: At any time you choose within one year of drawing this card, you can ask a question in meditation and mentally receive a truthful answer to that question.

traits.name: Skull
traits.description: An Avatar of Death (see the accompanying stat block) appears in an unoccupied space as close to you as possible. The avatar targets only you with its attacks, appearing as a ghostly skeleton clad in a tattered black robe and carrying a spectral scythe. The avatar disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or you die. If an ally of yours deals damage to the avatar, that ally summons another Avatar of Death. The new avatar appears in an unoccupied space as close to that ally as possible and targets only that ally with its attacks. You and your allies can each summon only one avatar as a consequence of this draw. A creature slain by an avatar can't be restored to life.

traits.name: Star
traits.description: Increase one of your ability scores by 2, to a maximum of 24.

traits.name: Sun
traits.description: A magic item (chosen by the GM) appears on your person. In addition, you gain 10 Temporary Hit Points daily at dawn until you die.

traits.name: Talons
traits.description: Every magic item you wear or carry disintegrates. Artifacts in your possession vanish instead.

traits.name: Throne
traits.description: You gain proficiency and Expertise in your choice of History, Insight, Intimidation, or Persuasion. In addition, you gain rightful ownership of a small keep somewhere in the world. However, the keep is currently home to one or more monsters, which must be cleared out before you can claim the keep as yours.

traits.name: Void
traits.description: Your soul is drawn from your body and contained in an object in a place of the GM's choice. One or more powerful beings guard the place. While your soul is trapped in this way, your body is inert, ceases aging, and requires no food, air, or water. A Wish spell can't return your soul to your body, but the spell reveals the location of the object that holds your soul. You draw no more cards.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.description: If the creature fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

poisons.name: Assassin’s Blood
poisons.description:
Assassin’s Blood (150 GP) Ingested Poison
A creature subjected to Assassin’s Blood makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 6 (1d12) Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition for 24 hours. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

poisons.name: Burnt Othur Fumes
poisons.description:
Burnt Othur Fumes (500 GP) Inhaled Poison
A creature subjected to Burnt Othur Fumes must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) Poison damage, and it must repeat the save at the start of each of its turns. On each successive failed save, the creature takes 3 (1d6) Poison damage. After three successful saves, the poison ends.

poisons.name: Crawler Mucus
poisons.description:
Crawler Mucus (200 GP) Contact Poison
A creature subjected to Crawler Mucus must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. The creature also has the Paralyzed condition while Poisoned in this way. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

poisons.name: Essence of Ether
poisons.description:
Essence of Ether (300 GP) Inhaled Poison
A creature subjected to Essence of Ether must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition for 8 hours.
